# dsh-community-bench
**In-app Community Bench tab for the dsh-score public evidence layer.**
Reads the same public registry everyone sees. No local scoring, no telemetry, no paid rank.
简体中文 · Español · Português · हिन्दी
> 🧊 **FROZEN — 2026-10-31. Maintenance mode.** No new scoring or ranking features; the package stays
— 2026-10-31. Maintenance mode.** No new scoring or ranking features; the package stays installable.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Community plugin, not affiliated with DeepSeek. Canonical repository: <https://github.com/PerryLink/
dsh-community-bench> (Gitee is a mirror).
## Maintenance status: 🧊 FROZEN
Frozen on 2026-10-31 in maintenance mode. The public evidence layer lives in `dsh-attention-index`;
this bench remains a reference consumer.
**In-app Community Bench tab for the `dsh-score` public evidence layer.**
*Reads the same public registry everyone sees. No local scoring, no telemetry, no paid rank.*
English · 简体中文
[代码示例省略，未执行]

> **Status: reference consumer / maintenance mode.** No new scoring or ranking
> features. The publi

c evidence layer is `dsh-score-index` (currently
> `dsh-attention-index`; repo rename pending).
## What it shows
- GOE (`E0`–`E5`) per surface. At the current snapshot: 41 rows are `E0 / unrated`, 1 row is `E2 / p

rovisional` (a null pilot); no positive measured row.
- Positive measured rows only in the quality b

lock; prior-only rows are labelled candidates, never `#1`.
- Prior, bench, coverage and **evidence c

ompleteness** (not a confidence probability).
- Community attention blocks and contributor reputatio

n.
- Link to the public evidence site and a refresh button.
The tab is a **consumer**: evidence and grading live in the public registry, not in this plugin. If
the live registry is unreachable, it falls back to the bundled snapshot and labels it.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then open **Settings → Plugins → Community Bench**.
## Configuration
The build injects two URLs (`scripts/build.mjs`):
| Env at build time | Default |

| `BENCH_SITE_URL` | `https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-attention-index/` |
| `BENCH_REGISTRY_URL` | `
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-attention-index/main/data/registry.json` |
If the registry is hosted elsewhere, rebuild with those variables.
## Limits
- The bundled snapshot is generated from `dsh-attention-index/data/registry.json`; it is a cache, no

t a second scoring path.
- The live fetch depends on the host allowing outbound HTTPS from the Web a

pp; on failure the tab stays on the snapshot.
- No local writes, no telemetry, no tools.
## DSH plugin family
| Project | Role |

| **dsh-score** | Local five-dimension prior inspector |
| **dsh-score index** | Public evidence lay

er (E0–E5, API, signals) |
| **dsh-community-bench** (this plugin) | In-app consumer |
| **dsh-kit**
| One-command family starter |
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你
这个插件是 DSH 插件家族的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。
